kpis.display_name: GMV that was facilitated using Shopify Payments
kpis.definition: GMV is the total dollar value of orders facilitated through Shopify's platform including certain apps and channels with revenue-sharing arrangements, net of refunds and inclusive of shipping and handling, duty and value-added taxes.
